answered.sql: SELECT type FROM Dive_Sites WHERE id IN (SELECT dive_site_id FROM Bookings GROUP BY dive_site_id) GROUP BY type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT scuba_center_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Scuba_Diving_Centers)

candidates.meaning: To find the types of dive sites available at each scuba diving center, we need to join the Scuba_Diving_Centers and Dive_Sites tables through the Bookings table to get the relationship between dive sites and scuba centers.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT SDC.name, DS.type FROM Scuba_Diving_Centers SDC JOIN Bookings B ON SDC.id = B.scuba_center_id JOIN Dive_Sites DS ON DS.id = B.dive_site_id

candidates.meaning: List the types of dive sites available at each scuba diving center.
candidates.sql: SELECT S.name AS scuba_center_name, DS.type FROM Scuba_Diving_Centers S JOIN Bookings B ON S.id = B.scuba_center_id JOIN Dive_Sites DS ON B.dive_site_id = DS.id GROUP BY S.name, DS.type

candidates.meaning: List the types of dive sites that have been booked at each scuba diving center.
candidates.sql: SELECT S.name AS scuba_center_name, DS.type FROM Scuba_Diving_Centers S JOIN Bookings B ON S.id = B.scuba_center_id JOIN Dive_Sites DS ON B.dive_site_id = DS.id GROUP BY S.name, DS.type

candidates.meaning: List the types of dive sites that are available (not necessarily booked) at each scuba diving center.
candidates.sql: SELECT S.name AS scuba_center_name, DS.type FROM Scuba_Diving_Centers S JOIN Dive_Sites DS ON S.id = DS.scuba_center_id GROUP BY S.name, DS.type
